jobs.description: We offer €15.52 to €17.05 gross per hour. A part-time 7 months contract for 15–20 hours per week and the intention to extend 8% holiday pay, 10% holiday hours and a 5% year-end bonus. An extra day off on your birthday! Working hours 15–20 hours per week Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Starting at 9am and finishing when the work is done, mostly around 17pm This job is perfect if you're looking for a part-time job with regular working days. Check here how a day working with us looks like EW Facility Services For over 30 years, EW Facility Services has provided cleaning and facility services across the Netherlands. With around 3,500 colleagues, we work in hotels, offices, hospitals and other locations. Every day, we help create clean, safe and welcoming places for guests, visitors and employees. At EW, we care about our people. We work together, support each other and offer opportunities to learn and grow. You are Available on Friday, Saturday and Sunday from 9am Happy to work in a team. Reliable and motivated. Someone who enjoys cleaning and pays attention to details. Able to communicate in English or Dutch. Living in Amsterdam or nearby No experience? That's okay! We'll show you how everything works. Apply Would you like to work at Hotel Casa in Amsterdam? Apply today! We look forward to meeting you!
